title: Planner input
description: The named data blocks the prompt assembly renders into the prompt of the planner. Each value is untrusted text and is rendered inside its own block; none of it becomes an instruction.

repository_map.description: The repository map from the repository stage.

plan_metadata.description: The identifiers, hashes and time the factory assigned to this plan. Copy them unchanged into `metadata`.

rework_findings.description: Findings from a failed plan check in an earlier round, when there are any.
